messages:
Vikram S: Quick FYI 1300: PR #1856 updated the Optimize quickstart to include batching + prefetch examples but CI flagged a few small issues: the YAML snippet uses `batching: auto` (deprecated) and the quant-profile URL is a relative anchor that 404s on prod.

Elena Q: I saw the lint error too. Also noticed the Python SDK snippet omits `dtype` which caused confusion in a support ticket when customers switched to q8 models.

Vikram S: Proposed micro-plan: 1) change `batching: auto` -> explicit `batch_size: 24` with a `# tune per workload` comment, 2) add `# dtype: float32` to the quickstart example, 3) swap quant link to the canonical alias `https://docs.redwood.ai/qprofiles/latest`, 4) add a tiny diagnostic curl to the migration guide showing how to check `meta.prefetch.mode`.

Harper L: Sounds good. For the diagnostic, suggest this minimal snippet:
```
# diagnostic: verify prefetch mode
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-opt-13b","input":"prefix...","trace":true}' | jq '.meta.prefetch.mode'
```
Expect "automatic" for hosted defaults.

Zoe M: Can we also add a one-line programmatic example for each SDK to set prefetch? Customers like seeing both YAML + code. e.g., `client.config.prefetch.mode = "automatic"` for Python and `Client.Config.Prefetch.Mode = PrefetchMode.Automatic` for C#.

Elena Q: I'll patch the PR to add the dtype comment and swap the quant link. Also add the `batch_size: 24` substitute and the SDK one-liners. Will run `make docs-lint` locally to confirm anchors.

doc-ci: PR #1856 1300 check run started (docs-ci). 2 checks queued.

Vikram S: Don't forget to add a changelog line and reference ticket DOCS-910 in the PR description so GA release notes pick it up.

Harper L: Small troubleshooting note request from CS: when switching to q4/q8, some customers see short-prefix truncation due to cache block alignment. Can we add a short bullet in migration guide advising to run tokenization/count diagnostics and, if needed, use `max_tokens`-based batching?

Zoe M: I'll draft the troubleshooting bullet and a simple token-count pseudo-check for the guide:
```
# token count compare (pseudo)
echo "long prefix" | tokenizer --model rwd-opt-13b | wc -w
echo "long prefix" | tokenizer --model rwd-opt-13b-q4_0 | wc -w
```
Recommend switching batching strategy if counts differ significantly.

Elena Q: Pushed quick patch: replaced `batching: auto` with `batch_size: 24 # tune per workload`, added `# dtype: float32` in the snippet, swapped quant link to `https://docs.redwood.ai/qprofiles/latest`, and included SDK one-liners. PR description updated with DOCS-910 and a short changelog blurb.

doc-ci: PR #1856 1300 check run succeeded (docs-ci). 4 checks passed.

Vikram S: Nice. Can someone open an infra redirect ticket for the old anchor `/optimize/qprofiles/old` -> `/qprofiles/latest`? If infra is slow, we still want the alias in docs so bookmarks resolve.

Harper L: Filed REDWOOD-1102 for redirect. Included suggested redirect entry.

Zoe M: After merge, please add a short note in the release notes under "Docs" so CS and AE teams know the quickstart clarifications are live. I'll draft the note.

Elena Q: Merged PR #1856. Site redeploy queued.

doc-ci: PR #1856 merged by Elena Q 1300 site redeploy started.

Vikram S: Verified staging: quickstart shows explicit `batch_size` and `dtype` comment, quant link resolves, diagnostic + troubleshooting bullets are live. Closing DOCS-910. :tada:
